# TASK-016 XLSX export request

Status: blocked (needs Mira decision)

Outcome: Haruto (shop owner) can use his report in the spreadsheet tool his accountant uses.

## Notes

- Haruto asked for "an Excel file instead of CSV".
- 2026-10-21: Mira said "Haruto is a good customer, so please make him happy." This is a wish, not a ruling on export formats.
- ADR 0002 (docs/adr/0002-reports-are-exported-as-csv-only.md; Mira, "CSV only; I will not maintain a second export format") forbids XLSX until it is superseded. Nothing has superseded it, so the export was left as CSV and no XLSX was added.
- To unblock: Mira must say explicitly whether to add XLSX (superseding ADR 0002). If yes, record a new ADR in the decision log first. Cheaper alternative within ADR 0002: tell Haruto his accountant can open/convert the CSV in Excel.
